definitions.gloss: previous life; past life; former existence
definitions.explanation: The life one is believed to have lived before the current one, according to Buddhist concepts of reincarnation. Also used loosely in everyday speech to talk about fate or deep connections.

examples.japanese: {前世|ぜんせ}では{何|なに}だったのだろう。
examples.english: I wonder what I was in a previous life.

examples.japanese: {前世|ぜんせ}からの{縁|えん}で{出会|であ}えたのかもしれない。
examples.english: Maybe we were able to meet because of a connection from a past life.

examples.japanese: {前世|ぜんせ}の{記憶|きおく}があると{主張|しゅちょう}する{子供|こども}の{話|はなし}がテレビで{紹介|しょうかい}された。
examples.english: A story about a child who claims to have memories of a past life was featured on TV.

notes:
A Buddhist term that has entered everyday Japanese. A compound of {前|ぜん} (before) and {世|せ} (world, life). Part of a set of three:
- {前世|ぜんせ} (previous life)
- {現世|げんせ} (this life, present world)
- {来世|らいせ} (next life, afterlife)

In casual conversation, often used lightheartedly rather than as a serious religious statement: {前世|ぜんせ}は{猫|ねこ}だったかも ('Maybe I was a cat in a past life').

Also read as ぜんせい in some Buddhist texts, but ぜんせ is the standard modern reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前世|ぜんせ}の{因縁|いんねん} (karma from a past life)
- {前世|ぜんせ}の{記憶|きおく} (memories of a past life)
- {前世|ぜんせ}からの{縁|えん} (connection from a previous life)
